title: Baked Sweet Potatoes
subtitle: with Harissa Chickpeas and Feta
description: If it's flavour you're after, this has got it all: harissa-spiced chickpeas, soft roasted sweet potato and creamy feta, with a fresh tomato salsa to bring it all together.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 220C. Line two oven trays with baking paper. Peel the sweet potato, then cut lengthwise into 1.5cm-thick slices (see Kitchen tips). Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Cut the tomatoes into quarters. Finely chop the coriander, including the stems.
Roast sweet potato: Put the sweet potato on one lined tray, brush with 1 tbs olive oil, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Roast, turning halfway, for 15-20 mins until golden and tender.

Cook chickpeas: Meanwhile, put the chickpeas, 2 tsp harissa seasoning (see Kitchen tips), 2 tsp olive oil and 2 tsp tomato paste in a bowl. Season with salt and stir to coat. Spread the chickpeas over the remaining lined tray and bake for 10 minutes or until crisp.
Make tomato salsa: Meanwhile, put the tomato, coriander, 1 tbs red wine vinegar, 2 tsp olive oil, 1 tsp dijon mustard and ¼ tsp sugar in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper and stir to combine.
Serve up: Divide the sweet potato among plates and top with the chickpeas and tomato salsa. Scatter over the feta and enjoy.

Kitchen tips: The sweet potato can be difficult to cut lengthways. If you find this too hard, cut the sweet potato on an angle into 1.5cm-thick rounds. ~ Harissa contains chilli, so if you are cooking for young children, you can add 1 tsp harissa seasoning to half the chickpea and tomato paste mixture and roast on separate ends of the oven tray.
